relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine is a novel, selective Nav1.8 sodium channel inhibitor that appears to have promising antinociceptive potential.

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine was ultimately tried with significant pain relief, making this the first described case of suzetrigine alleviating erythromelalgia-associated pain.

key_findings: First reported case of suzetrigine (Nav1.8 inhibitor) giving significant pain relief in erythromelalgia after other interventions failed.
